about: HW H2 tensor-core parity fix, round 3: the split of round 2 with its residuals scaled into fp16's normal range and their products in a separate accumulator (after Ootomo and Yokota, 2022). Follows evidence/rr-tc-split-note-2026-10-15.json; changes no bound.
written: 2026-10-15 21:51Z, after round 2's RTX failure and the flush-to-zero emulation, before the scaled emulation, the shader change or any run
change: activation residual lo_a = fp16((v - hi) * 2^11), weight residual likewise; main accumulator += hi_a x hi_w; correction accumulator += hi_a x lo_w + lo_a x hi_w; output = main + correction x 2^-11, then the bias. Scaling keeps the residuals normal (|lo| at most |v|, so no new overflow); the separate accumulator keeps the small correction terms from being truncated against the large main sum.

bounds.parity: unchanged: at most 1e-2 on every raw_hero pixel on the RTX 4090, validation on
bounds.controls_that_must_fail: the unsplit path (control_coop_unsplit) in the same run; the scalar perturbed control

predictions.emulation: mode SS with --ftz on raw_hero: max at most 1e-3 (if the flush is the whole cause, scaling removes it)
predictions.rtx_parity: max at most 5e-3; if it lands between 5e-3 and 1e-2 the bound holds but the model of the hardware is incomplete, and that is recorded; above 1e-2 is a failure, and the next step is fp32 for the head layer only or the scalar path
predictions.rtx_speed: the convolutions cost at most 0.3 ms more than round 2's 5.69 ms (two more accumulators, one more scale-add per tile)

does_not_prove: that the tensor cores flush subnormals (the emulation agrees with it; the hardware's rounding is not documented to us); anything about other models or scenes

results.rtx_parity: FAIL. Lock 22:32Z to 22:42Z: round 3 max 0.118 at frame 54, pixel 64,578 (the same firefly), mean 3.16e-6; unsplit control 0.130 (fails); scalar 2.93e-3; perturbed fails; 0 validation errors. Prediction (at most 5e-3) failed. Operand precision, with and without the flush, is not what limits the worst pixels on this hardware: round 2 and round 3 halve the mean error but leave the fireflies near 0.12.
results.rtx_speed: FAIL against the prediction: convolutions 7.63 to 7.65 ms (round 2 5.69; predicted at most +0.3 ms, measured +1.95); frame 14.69 to 14.74 ms
results.next: round 4 (below), a diagnosis: the accumulation inside the tensor-core multiply-add chain

round4.written: 2026-10-15 22:43Z, before the change or any run
round4.hypothesis: the tensor cores accumulate the multiply-add chain with alignment and truncation (Fasi, Higham, Mikaitis and Pranesh, 2021, measured this on earlier NVIDIA generations), so a long chain loses low bits regardless of operand precision
round4.change: round 3, except every K step multiplies into a fresh zero accumulator and adds that tile to the running fp32 accumulators with a cooperative-matrix addition outside the multiply-add
round4.prediction: if the chain's accumulation is the cause: RTX max at most 5e-3 on raw_hero. If max stays above 1e-2, the hypothesis is refuted, the tensor-core path is left as it is on main, and the cause stays open
round4.bounds: unchanged; same controls (unsplit must fail, perturbed must fail, scalar regression on SwiftShader)
